connector.name: Sequesign
connector.registryDescription: Cryptographically verifiable receipts of an agent's delegated work, verified offline.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sequesign account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SEQUESIGN_MODE
env.description: Transport: 'direct' (default; sign locally, an independent witness co-signs) or 'managed' (route through the Sequesign broker for a registered identity).

env.name: SEQUESIGN_API_KEY
env.description: Sequesign write-class API key (from the dashboard). Required for managed mode; in direct mode it authenticates the hosted witness.

env.name: SEQUESIGN_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private-key PEM for the agent. In managed mode, the key registered to your API key. In direct mode, omit to mint an ephemeral key per session.

env.name: SEQUESIGN_PACKAGE_DIR
env.description: Directory where sealed receipt packages are written. Defaults to a temporary directory.
